briefing_ko:
- **[Liquid Network](https://rekt.news/liquid-network-rekt)** (Bitcoin·Liquid) — 캐시 키 충돌로 무담보 L-BTC를 만들고 SideSwap을 통해 3,996 BTC를 탈취, 약 $320M 손실.
- **[custom Safe module](https://cointelegraph.com/news/mev-bot-intercepts-77m-in-rseth-from-ethereum-wallet-exploit)** (Ethereum) — 공격자가 Safe 모듈을 이용해 rsETH를 인출하려 했으나 Yoink 봇이 앞서 $7.7M을 가로채 회수.
- **Robinhood** — 내부자 거래·사기 혐의, 금액 미공개.
- **Select Decks / Vin Phat** — 연방 검찰이 $245M 규모 PPP·EIDL 사기 적발, 다수 피고인 기소.
- **소액** — Bonfiretoken $50K, SpiralHookV2 $10.7K 기존 블랙리스트 1개 재등장.
- **시사점** — 프로토콜이 가격 오라클을 단일 체인 가격에 의존하면 연속 공격에 취약합니다.
briefing_en:
- **[Liquid Network](https://rekt.news/liquid-network-rekt)** (Bitcoin·Liquid) — cache-key collision minted uncollateralized L-BTC, SideSwap peg-out stole 3,996 BTC (~$320M).
- **[custom Safe module](https://cointelegraph.com/news/mev-bot-intercepts-77m-in-rseth-from-ethereum-wallet-exploit)** (Ethereum) — attacker tried to pull rsETH via a Safe module, Yoink MEV bot front-ran and captured $7.7M.
- **Robinhood** — DOJ indictment for insider-trading and fraud by Hefu Chai and Huaisong Xiang, amount undisclosed.
- **Select Decks / Vin Phat** — federal prosecutors busted a $245M PPP/EIDL fraud scheme, multiple defendants charged.
- **Smaller** — Bonfiretoken $50K, SpiralHookV2 $10.7K 1 on our blacklist.
- **Takeaway** — Protocols that depend on a single-chain price oracle keep getting hit.
